title: Python is No Longer Mandatory
description:
Should you learn Python in 2026? Here's the honest verdict: Python isn't dead, but it's no longer mandatory. It comes down to your goal. If you're a professional, you need Python, so learn it properly like you always would have. 

If you're a builder, build first and let the language come to you naturally when you need it. And if you're just trying to stay literate with what's happening in AI, focus on the AI tools directly and don't worry much about code unless a specific reason calls for it. 

The right answer depends entirely on which of those you are.

#techwithtim #python #learntocode
